title: krn adopt keeps a repository's AGENTS.md within its own size budget instead of inlining every standard
body:
Source: S29 rehearsal 2026-11-16, krn adopt on a scratch clone of boilerplate-2026 main 2fb16ac (logs .krn/tmp/s29/adopt2.log, t1.log post-adopt suite, t26.log pristine suite under the pinned Node 26: 62 pass, 2 fail only from an untrusted mise config in a temp dir).
Defect: adopt appends a 59-line rules block that inlines every applicable standards record (26.7 KB); boilerplate's own test caps AGENTS.md at 3 KB (tests/agents.test.mjs 'the contract stays under 3 KB'). North star item 2 says the brain serves records at the moment of need (S11 standards skill routes to krn standards query).
Outcome: the adopt block names the standards skill and query command, not the record list; the repository's own AGENTS.md test stays green.
Proof: node --test test/adopt/adopt.test.ts: pass (the adopt block of a repository with 30+ applicable records is under 2 KB).
